camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro BatchKillSessionList --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4louaeei0000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SessionList '342,354,343'
description_en: Performs a batch shutdown of session information between OceanBase Cloud and business applications. This operation is executed asynchronously. You must call the DescribeSessionList operation to authenticate whether the sessions are successfully shutdown
description_zh: 该接口用于批量关闭 OceanBase 云服务和业务之间的会话信息。该接口为异步执行，需要用户通过 DescribeSessionList 验证会话是否关闭成功
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro batch-kill-session-list --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id t4louaeei0000 --session-list 342,354,343 --region cn-hangzhou
